new: Direct messages print on their own one-page paper: you, the people it went to, and their answers with signatures.
Links in messages open when you tap them.
More: every page you can open, as app icons, with a search.
Glass Dock now has light and dark too.
fixed: Signatures print as ink only, without the paper background.
Every name on a paper now has its signature.
better: Every app icon has its own picture.
Sign out is a clear red bar.
If something goes wrong, a report with a picture of the screen goes to the Super Admin at once.
